data.narrative:
Improbable Defence is a Growth-stage frontier-technology company in the Defense & Security sector, founded by Joe Robinson, that has raised $703M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comp universe of 10 peers: 2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, Saronic, and Quantum-Systems.

A peer-median approach proved inapplicable due to insufficient granularity within the same-stage and adjacent-stage cohorts within Defense & Security; while 21 same-sector peers exist broadly, none of the narrow filters (same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier) yielded three or more datapoints necessary for reliable median derivation. A stage-progression method was therefore applied, using the $703M total raised as a valuation proxy and applying a 1.2x multiplier typical of Growth-to-next-stage step-ups, yielding an implied valuation of $844M.

The triangulated valuation range is $717M to $970M, with a median of $844M. This range reflects uncertainty inherent in reliance on a single methodological input rather than cross-validated approaches. The key constraint is the scarcity of same-stage, directly comparable private transaction data in the Defense & Security frontier-tech subsector. Further refinement would require either additional comparable transactions or disclosure of Improbable Defence's revenue, EBITDA, or ARR multiples relative to the identified peer set.
